headline: A research task turned into a live map of 80+ ecosystem projects
quote: What started as a research task turned into full-blown community project It spent the week mapping every tool, skill, and integration built for @NousResearch's Hermes Agent

headline: Signed tool cards so the agent verifies a tool before calling it
quote: Tool calling is the biggest unguarded attack surface in LLM agents. So I built Glyph Protocol: every tool ships as a cryptographically signed card.

headline: Mixture of Agents, explained: consult several models, one writes the answer
quote: Every agent commits to a single model, and every model has blind spots the others would have caught. … The unit you work with is a preset. Think of it as a recipe that names a few models to consult and one model to write the final answer, saved under a label you can reuse.

headline: How a specialist agent gets crafted: run it 4 to 10 times and let skills emerge
quote: you can't create a solid production agent from scratch. it needs to be crafted through iterations.
